assumptions.surface: Mean original image +z is inward normal; mean origin fixes plane offset.
assumptions.surface_x: Mean original image +x, orthogonalized against inward normal.
assumptions.footprint: Assumed 40x10 mm; not measured in source data.
assumptions.phantom_size: Scan footprint and vessel bounds, 10 mm margin per side, rounded up to 10 mm; assumed 40 mm depth.
assumptions.origin: Centre of inferred top rectangle; +z into phantom.
assumptions.contact: Bottom centre on plane; penetration allowed; no deformation or acoustic coupling model.
assumptions.mesh_extent: Source reconstruction closes scan ends at observed extent; unseen vessel is not extrapolated.
